initialExam.title: DSSSB Staff Nurse / Health Worker 2026
initialExam.description: DSSSB recruits Staff Nurses and health workers for Delhi government hospitals and health centers.
initialExam.eligibility: B.Sc Nursing / GNM, registered with Delhi Nursing Council
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → Document Verification → Medical → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Staff Nurse / Health Worker in Delhi government hospitals
initialExam.careerGrowth: Staff Nurse → Nursing Officer → Nursing Superintendent.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit dsssb.delhi.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, NPA, Medical, Pension, Delhi allowance
